title: Numeric representation
description: Choose the standard-library numeric strategy for jq values while preserving the corpus-compatible distinction between literal preservation and arithmetic conversion.
system_choice: Use decimal-backed literal values with explicit float conversion for arithmetic and compatibility branches; expose have_decnum as false where the corpus requires jq's non-decnum behavior.

title: Evaluation representation
description: Choose the implementation representation for jq's ordered multi-output filters.
system_choice: Use Python generators internally and materialize only at collection boundaries, preserving ordering, backtracking, and partial runtime output.

title: Acceptance criterion architecture-contract cannot pass
description:
ARCHITECTURE.md [architecture-contract]: invokes staged asset sources/run_conformance.py without JQ, which that asset declares required; supply it as env={**os.environ, 'JQ': ...}

The staged asset exits on its own usage code when the variable is absent, so this criterion is false under every implementation. Supply the variable in the Blueprint specification, or answer that the story is acceptable without the criterion. Never repair it by editing the staged asset: it is restored before grading and the edit is reported as tampering.
